notes: The owner: "Smalltalk environments have one Settings Browser, and a standard way to segment, display and modify settings and preferences… far more consistent than how we are currently providing settings… the 'Settings' menu will go to the new 'Settings Browser' which will replace the existing Settings Panel, with a new Floating panel displayed in the floating area." - The Pharo shape: one tree of groups and rows with inline widgets, a search field, an expand/collapse-all control, and a DESCRIPTION PANE at the bottom. The row emitters write sbLabel/sbHelp as they emit and the search and the pan
